cards.title: ASX 200 closes higher as miners and property lead
cards.dek: The ASX 200 added 0.6% on Tuesday to finish at 8,735.7, led by materials and real estate.
cards.insight: The local rally is being driven by sectors tied to commodities and capital costs, making rates and bond yields key for the next move.

cards.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit fresh records
cards.dek: Wall Street extended its rally on Tuesday, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq reaching record closing highs as yields eased.
cards.insight: Equities are absorbing high bond yields because earnings and AI expectations remain powerful enough to offset some valuation pressure.

cards.title: RBA cash rate now sits at 4.60%
cards.dek: The RBA raised the cash rate by 25 basis points on 29 September as inflation risks remained elevated.
cards.insight: Australia's higher-for-longer rate setting is a major cross-market driver for banks, households, property and equity valuations.

cards.title: Marvell jumps on huge AI revenue target
cards.dek: Marvell surged after targeting US$70bn–US$90bn of revenue by fiscal 2031, driven heavily by custom AI chips and networking.
cards.insight: The scale of the target shows how aggressively investors are pricing the build-out of AI infrastructure and hyperscale computing.

cards.title: Google signs 20-year nuclear deal with Constellation
cards.dek: Alphabet agreed to buy 890MW of nuclear power from Constellation, sending the utility sharply higher.
cards.insight: AI data centres need enormous amounts of reliable electricity, turning nuclear and grid capacity into an increasingly important investment theme.

cards.title: Oil retreats as supply fears ease
cards.dek: Brent crude moderated around the US$100 level after increased Middle East exports and a G7 emergency reserve release eased supply concerns.
cards.insight: A sustained oil pullback would help ease inflation pressure and could reduce the need for further monetary tightening.

cards.title: US Treasury yields remain the key equity risk
cards.dek: The US 10-year yield eased to about 5.27% after recently reaching its highest level in decades, keeping bond-market stress in focus.
cards.insight: Record equities and elevated yields can coexist, but another sustained rise in yields would put pressure on long-duration growth stocks.

cards.title: Gold rises as yields and dollar ease
cards.dek: Gold gained about 0.7% on Tuesday as lower Treasury yields and a softer US dollar supported demand for the precious metal.
cards.insight: Gold is benefiting from demand for diversification while investors remain uneasy about bond markets, fiscal risks and global geopolitics.

cards.title: Glencore set for Australian trading debut next week
cards.dek: Glencore expects to begin trading on the ASX under ticker GLC on 14 October through CHESS Depositary Interests.
cards.insight: The listing gives Australian investors direct access to a global mining major and adds another large resource name to the local market.
